description: Paths+patterns intentionally exempt from secret scanning. Each entry is a known fake credential inside a no-touch test fixture, pinned by exact repo-relative path, pattern label, and value_contains. The value substring is matched against the detected secret token (not the whole line), and an entry with an empty/absent value_contains never exempts — so a real secret added elsewhere, a different fake at the same path, or a real secret sharing a line with the fixture fake is still detected. Used by validate-no-secrets.sh.

allowlist.reason: Intentional fake AWS access key in the self-contained test fixture (global no-touch asset). Not a real credential; exists to exercise downstream tooling.
